description: 1920x1080 Canvas with single white square of dimensions, height 100 and width 100, and a black stroke of width 1. Square is positioned at the bottom left corner perfectly. The corner of the square is aligned with the bottom left corner of the canvas with bottom and left edges of both the canvas and the square aligned. The position of the square is defined by the x and y coordinates of the center of the square, the center of the square is at height/2 and width/2 which are the pivot coordinates for a square. Square has an animation that moves it to the top left corner perfectly, the animation is a move animation with a duration of 2 seconds, a power1.out easing meaning it starts fast and slows down, and a repeat of 0.
